d: Spiky, swept-back hair in a golden blonde shade with a thick texture. Sharp, narrow eyes in a light brown shade with a stern, focused expression. A mature appearance of a young adult with a lean, athletic build. A detailed suit of armor consisting of a polished silver gorget, layered bronze-colored breastplate and pauldrons with silver studs, and a silver chainmail coif covering the head. A large, broad sword is held over the shoulder.
